Representative B2B Project Scenario

Custom 40oz Tumblers for an Amazon Seller

This representative B2B sourcing scenario shows how product, customization, quality control, packaging and shipping could be planned for an Amazon FBA Private Label Seller. It is not a customer testimonial or a guaranteed project result.

body:
Project Overview Table

Client TypeAmazon FBA Private Label Seller
MarketUnited States (FBA Warehouse)
Product40oz Double-Wall Vacuum Insulated Tumbler with Handle & Straw
Quantity Range1,200 pcs (Initial Launch)
Customization RequestCustom Pantone color matching for gradient spray paint, laser-engraved brand logo, custom cardboard divider packaging, and FBA-compliant barcode labeling.
Logo MethodHigh-precision laser engraving (dishwasher-safe, no peeling)
Packaging SolutionsIndividually wrapped in biodegradable polybags, placed in standard egg-crate cardboard dividers to maximize shipping density and reduce cost.
Production Lead Time28 days from sample approval to bulk shipment ready
Shipping MethodDDP Sea Freight directly to Amazon FBA Warehouse in California

Scenario Requirements and Risks

In this scenario, the buyer needs to match a pastel color direction with a clean laser logo while controlling the packed volume of a bulky 40oz product. The RFQ should also identify the applicable marketplace barcode, carton and inbound-shipment requirements for the seller's account and destination.

Illustrative Planning Approach

  • Confirm the exact product and customization scope: Custom Pantone color matching for gradient spray paint, laser-engraved brand logo, custom cardboard divider packaging, and FBA-compliant barcode labeling.
  • Approve the proposed logo method on the selected surface: High-precision laser engraving (dishwasher-safe, no peeling)
  • Review the complete packed sample or packaging proof: Individually wrapped in biodegradable polybags, placed in standard egg-crate cardboard dividers to maximize shipping density and reduce cost.
  • Write the production target only after sample approval: 28 days from sample approval to bulk shipment ready
  • Compare the named shipping scope and destination: DDP Sea Freight directly to Amazon FBA Warehouse in California

Scenario Outcome and Acceptance Criteria

Acceptance would require the buyer to approve the exact sample or signed specification, artwork, packaging proof, inspection checklist, carton data, named destination and shipping term. This page illustrates a planning target only; it does not claim an actual order, customer endorsement, saving, delivery result or commercial outcome.
